row.notes: Optional out {u16,has}: needs settings from 0x140d82070; finds the row of driver key param_3; rating = 0x14113d120([this+0x360]); flag = 0x140d822a0 (rows without +0x4b&0x10) or a days check vs this+0x2d0; band 0x200 if rating >= threshold1, 0x100 if >= threshold2; out = flag|band. Not a cached overall rating. Better name: Career_DriverMarket_GetDriverRatingBand (bound record keeps its name).

verify.notes: V9533 Does call Career_Get_DriverOverallRating (14113d120) but returns a small result (bool | threshold bucket 0x100/0x200 plus validity byte) from comparing the rating, not the rating itself.
